words.ex_cn: 他住在意大利的一个小城市墨西拿。
words.en: Messina is a port city in northeastern Sicily, Italy, known for its strategic location and historical significance.

words.tr: n. 伯罗奔尼撒（希腊南部的一个半岛）
words.ex: He visited the Peloponnese last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了伯罗奔尼撒。
words.en: The Peloponnese is a peninsula and geographic region in southern Greece, connected to the central part of the country by the Isthmus of Corinth.

words.ex: He works hard to emulate his older brother.
words.ex_cn: 他努力赶上他的哥哥。
words.en: To emulate someone or something means to try to be like them or to do something in the same way that they do it.

words.ex: The authenticity of the ancient painting was confirmed by experts.
words.ex_cn: 这幅古画的真实性得到了专家的确认。
words.en: The quality of being genuine or not corrupted from the original.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 深入探究；深入研究
words.ex: He delves into ancient history books.
words.ex_cn: 他深入钻研古代历史书籍。
words.en: To delve into something means to try to discover new information about it or to examine it in detail.

words.ex: He felt great woe after losing his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他失去狗后感到极大的悲伤。
words.en: Woe is great sadness.

words.tr: adj. （衣服或其他布制品）有装饰的；镶边的；修整过的; v. 修剪；减少；减肥；（尤指用有明显差...
words.ex: He trimmed the bushes every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上修剪灌木。
words.en: To make something neat or of the desired size or form by cutting away irregular or unwanted parts.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.tr: adj. 神秘的；不可思议的；
words.ex: The uncanny silence in the forest made him nervous.
words.ex_cn: 森林里那神秘的寂静让他感到紧张。
words.en: If you describe something as uncanny, you mean that it is strange and difficult to explain.

words.ex: There is a resemblance between the two brothers.
words.ex_cn: 这两兄弟之间有相似之处。
words.en: If there is a resemblance between two people or things, they are similar to each other.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细想；考虑；反思；带来不良影响
words.ex: He likes to reflect on his day before sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在睡觉前反思自己的一天。
words.en: If you reflect on something, you think deeply about it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对…有切身利益；在…中拥有股份或利益
words.ex: He has a stake in the small business.
words.ex_cn: 他在这间小企业中有股份。
words.en: To have a financial or other interest in the success or outcome of something.

words.ex: He looked intently at the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他专心地看着这道数学题。
words.en: If you do something intently, you are giving it your full attention.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.ex: The baby was sleeping in the cradle.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在吊架里睡觉。
words.en: A cradle is a small bed for a baby, which can be rocked from side to side. It can also refer to the place or period in which something begins or is developed.

words.tr: adj. 极好的；令人震惊的； v. “stun”的现在分词；
words.ex: She wore a stunning dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件极好的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Extremely impressive or attractive.

words.ex: The beach remains unspoilt by tourism.
words.ex_cn: 这片海滩尚未被旅游业破坏。
words.en: If you describe a place as unspoilt, you think it is beautiful because it has not been changed or built on for a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 涅斯托尔王（古希腊神话中皮洛斯贤明而长寿的国王，特洛伊战争中的资深顾问）
words.ex: King Nestor ruled a small kingdom long ago.
words.ex_cn: 很久以前，涅斯托尔国王统治着一个小王国。
words.en: A wise and respected leader in Greek mythology, often used to refer to an experienced elder.

words.tr: n. 荷马（公元前9世纪前后的希腊盲诗人）；本垒打
words.ex: Homer wrote the Iliad and the Odyssey.
words.ex_cn: 荷马写了《伊利亚特》和《奥德赛》。
words.en: In baseball, a homer is a home run, which is a hit that allows the batter to make a complete circuit of the bases and score a run. In navigation, a homer is a device that guides a vehicle or vessel back to its starting point.

words.ex: He went on an odyssey to find his lost brother.
words.ex_cn: 他踏上了一段寻找失散兄弟的漫长旅程。
words.en: An odyssey is a long and eventful or adventurous journey or experience.

words.ex: They found an archaeological site near the river.
words.ex_cn: 他们在河边发现了一个考古遗址。
words.en: Relating to the study of human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites and the analysis of artifacts and other physical remains.

words.ex: He read the previous chapter last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了前一章。
words.en: Existing or occurring before in time or order.

words.ex: The old book had a powdery cover.
words.ex_cn: 那本旧书的封面有粉末状的质感。
words.en: Resembling or consisting of powder; covered with powder.

words.ex: The sunset was spectacular.
words.ex_cn: 日落非常壮观。
words.en: Something that is spectacular is very impressive or dramatic.

words.tr: v. 参与；从事；吸引；与…建立密切关系；
words.ex: He engages in community volunteer work.
words.ex_cn: 他参与社区志愿工作。
words.en: To engage means to occupy, attract, or involve someone or oneself in a particular activity or situation.

words.ex: Children have reliance on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子依赖父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: Reliance is the state of depending on or trusting in someone or something.

words.ex: Farming is his main livelihood.
words.ex_cn: 务农是他的主要生计。
words.en: A person's livelihood is the way they earn money in order to live.

words.tr:
n. 同辈；同等的人；
v. 凝视；
words.ex: He feels comfortable talking to his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得和同辈交谈很自在。
words.en: A peer is someone who is equal to another in abilities, qualifications, age, background, or social status. As a verb, to peer means to look keenly or with difficulty at someone or something.

words.ex: He started afresh after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后从头开始。
words.en: If you do something afresh, you do it again in a different way, often in a way that is better than before.

words.tr: adj. 干瘦的；干瘪的；皱缩的
words.ex: The wizened old man told stories by the fire.
words.ex_cn: 那位皱纹满面的老人在火炉旁讲故事。
words.en: If you describe someone as wizened, you mean they are old and have a lot of lines on their skin, often because they have had a hard life.

words.ex: The movie shows too much violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了太多的暴力。
words.en: Violence is behavior which is intended to hurt, injure, or kill people.

words.tr: phrase. 只要；长达；和 ... 一样长
words.ex: You can stay out as long as you come home before midnight.
words.ex_cn: 只要你午夜前回家，你就可以在外面待着。
words.en: used to say that one thing is true or will happen only if another thing is true or happens

words.ex: He felt intense pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到剧烈的疼痛。
words.en: If you describe an activity as intense, you mean that it is very serious and concentrated, and often involves doing a great deal in a short time.

words.tr: phrase. 涉及；专心； 卷入
words.ex: He is involved in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他参与了学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To be included or participate in something, especially something that requires a lot of time or effort.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 卷入，参与，牵涉进（某事）
words.ex: He became involved in a school project.
words.ex_cn: 他参与了一个学校项目。
words.en: To become involved in something means to take part in or be connected with it in some way.

words.tr: n. 裁判；介绍人；仲裁者
words.ex: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
words.ex_cn: 裁判吹哨判罚犯规。
words.en: A referee is an official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are adhered to and sometimes to arbitrate on matters arising from the play.

words.tr: adj. 对立的； v. 反对；“oppose”的现在分词；
words.ex: The two teams have opposing views on the rule change.
words.ex_cn: 这两支队伍对规则修改持有对立的观点。
words.en: If you are opposing someone or something, you are competing against them or trying to prevent them from doing something.

words.tr:
n. 肘部
v. 用肘推挤
words.ex: He hurt his elbow while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打篮球时伤了肘部。
words.en: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm; to push someone with your elbow.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: The riot broke out after the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后爆发了骚乱。
words.en: A riot is a violent disturbance of the peace by a crowd.

words.ex: The old man muttered a curse under his breath.
words.ex_cn: 老人低声嘟囔了一句诅咒。
words.en: A curse is a word or sentence that is used to wish evil or harm on someone or something.

words.ex: He punched the wall in anger.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地打了墙一拳。
words.en: To punch means to hit someone or something hard with your fist, or to make a hole in something using a tool.

words.ex: He turned against his friend because of a big argument.
words.ex_cn: 他因为一次大争吵而背弃了他的朋友。
words.en: To change from being friendly or supportive to being hostile or opposed to someone or something.

words.ex: The weather was unfavorable for the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 天气对野餐不利。
words.en: If conditions or circumstances are unfavorable, they make it difficult for something to happen or exist.

words.ex: The smoke made him choke.
words.ex_cn: 烟让他窒息。
words.en: If you choke, or if something chokes you, you cannot breathe properly because there is not enough air or because something is blocking your throat.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；
n. 大调；主修课；
words.ex: Math is a major subject in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学是学校里的主要科目。
words.en: A major is a student's principal field of study or specialization in college or university.

words.tr: n. 延长赛；季后赛；最后决赛
words.ex: The two teams competed in a playoff to decide the champion.
words.ex_cn: 这两支球队在延长赛中竞争冠军。
words.en: A playoff is a series of games played after the regular season in order to determine the champion or to qualify for a higher level of competition.

words.ex: He is physically tired after running five kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完五公里后身体上很累。
words.en: In a way that relates to the body as opposed to the mind; in a way that relates to things that can be seen or touched.

words.ex: He answered the questions orally.
words.ex_cn: 他口头回答了问题。
words.en: In a spoken rather than written form; by means of speech.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.tr: v. 暂停；中止；延期； suspending
words.ex: The school will suspend the class due to snow.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雪，学校将暂停课程。
words.en: If you suspend something, you delay it or stop it from happening for a while or until a decision is made about it.

words.ex: There is a chance it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天可能会下雨。
words.en: A chance is a possibility of something happening, often something that you want to happen.

words.tr:
n. 减少；
v. 减少；降低；
words.ex: There was a decrease in rainfall last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月降雨量减少了。
words.en: If something decreases or you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.ex: He spoke on behalf of his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他代表他的妹妹发言。
words.en: If you do something on behalf of someone, you do it as their representative or in their interest.

words.tr: v. 投入；献身；“devote”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 全心全意的；投入的；
words.ex: He devoted all his time to helping his students.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有时间都投入到了帮助学生上。
words.en: If you are devoted to something, you care about it a lot and are very enthusiastic about it.

words.ex: He ate only a small portion of the cake.
words.ex_cn: 他只吃了一小部分蛋糕。
words.en: A portion of something is a part of it.

words.ex: He obviously forgot his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他显然忘了做作业。
words.en: in a way that is easily perceived or understood; clearly.

words.ex: He works in financial planning.
words.ex_cn: 他从事财政规划工作。
words.en: Relating to finance or the management of large amounts of money.

words.ex: The company will advertise its new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司将在电视上为新手机登广告。
words.en: If you advertise something such as a product, an event, or a job, you tell people about it in newspapers, on television, or on posters in order to encourage them to buy the product, go to the event, or apply for the job.

words.ex: The retailer sells clothes to customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家零售商向顾客出售衣服。
words.en: A retailer is a person or business that sells goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.ex: He is a wealthy man who owns many houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是个富有的人，拥有许多房子。
words.en: A wealthy person, organization, or country has a lot of money, resources, or assets.

words.ex: He is a talented singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有才能的歌手。
words.en: Someone who is talented has a natural ability to do something well.

words.ex: He resolved the problem with a simple plan.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个简单的计划解决了问题。
words.en: If you resolve to do something, you make a firm decision to do it.

words.ex: The violent storm destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场暴力的风暴摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: If someone is violent, or if they do something that is violent, they use physical force or weapons to hurt, injure, or kill other people.

words.ex: The storm is a threat to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对村庄构成了威胁。
words.en: A threat is a statement of an intention to inflict pain, injury, damage, or other hostile action on someone in retribution for something done or not done.

words.tr: phrase. 与…有麻烦；惹…生气；受到…的责难
words.ex: He is in trouble with his teacher for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而惹老师生气了。
words.en: Having problems or difficulties with someone or something, often leading to potential negative consequences.

words.ex: Water is a basic necessity for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本必需品。
words.en: Something that is necessary or indispensable.

words.ex: The store sells cheap merchandise.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售廉价商品。
words.en: Goods to be bought and sold.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: He acted in the name of justice.
words.ex_cn: 他以正义的名义行动。
words.en: If you do something in the name of a particular cause or principle, you do it in order to support that cause or principle.

words.tr: phrase. 脾气暴躁；易怒的性格
words.ex: He has a short temper and gets angry easily.
words.ex_cn: 他脾气暴躁，容易生气。
words.en: A tendency to become angry or irritated very quickly.

words.ex: Everyone passed the test, with one exception.
words.ex_cn: 所有人都通过了考试，只有一个例外。
words.en: An exception is a person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.ex: The case will be heard in court next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件将于下周在法院审理。
words.en: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.ex: The scandal made the news last week.
words.ex_cn: 这起丑闻上周上了新闻。
words.en: A scandal is a situation or event that is thought to be shocking and immoral and that everyone knows about.

words.tr: adj．提高表现的，增强性能的：用于描述能够提高运动员或其他人在某项活动中的表现的药物、技术或方法。
words.ex: He took performance-enhancing drugs to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他服用了增强表现的药物来赢得比赛。
words.en: Describes a substance or method that improves physical performance, often used in the context of sports and athletics.

words.ex: The poison contained strychnine.
words.ex_cn: 这种毒药含有士的宁。
words.en: Strychnine is a bitter, highly toxic alkaloid derived from the seeds of the nux vomica tree and related plants, used as a pesticide and in medicine.

words.ex: Caffeine is a common stimulant.
words.ex_cn: 咖啡因是一种常见的兴奋剂。
words.en: A stimulant is a substance that raises levels of physiological or nervous activity in the body.

words.tr: phrase. 抄近路通过；越（界）；影响，涉及（不同群体）；违背
words.ex: The path cuts across the field.
words.ex_cn: 这条路穿过田野。
words.en: If an issue or problem cuts across different groups of people, it affects or matters to all those groups.

words.ex: He has ideological beliefs about freedom.
words.ex_cn: 他有关于自由的思想信念。
words.en: Relating to or concerned with ideas, especially of a political or economic nature.

words.tr: n. 社会学家；社会学者；
words.ex: The sociologist studied how people live in cities.
words.ex_cn: 这位社会学家研究了人们在城市中的生活方式。
words.en: A sociologist is someone who studies or is an expert in sociology, which is the study of society and social behavior.

words.ex: The police will investigate the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方将调查这起事故。
words.en: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

words.tr: phrase. 搁置一旁；保留；储存...备用
words.ex: He put aside his money for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱存起来用于旅行。
words.en: To place something to one side; to save something for future use.

words.ex: The unfair verdict caused public outrage.
words.ex_cn: 不公正的判决引发了公众的愤怒。
words.en: An outrage is an extremely strong reaction of anger, shock, or indignation.

words.tr: phrase. 覆盖范围的文字说明；用于描述某项服务或产品覆盖区域的标注文字
words.ex: The map includes a coverage lettering that explains the service areas.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图包含了一段文字说明，解释了服务范围。
words.en: Text or lettering used to describe or provide information about an insurance policy's coverage.

words.tr: n. 解说词；评论；实况报道；
words.ex: The commentator gave live commentary during the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 解说员在足球比赛期间进行了现场解说。
words.en: A commentary is a spoken or written description of an event or situation that is broadcast or published as it occurs.

words.tr: n. 短跑运动员；短程竞赛选手；
words.ex: The sprinter ran faster than all others in the race.
words.ex_cn: 这名短跑运动员在比赛中跑得比其他所有人都快。
words.en: A sprinter is an athlete who specializes in short-distance races.

words.tr:
n. 长条；条状；
v. 剥去；剥夺；
words.ex: He cut a strip of paper to wrap the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他剪了一条纸来包装礼物。
words.en: To remove a layer from something, or to take off your clothes.

words.tr:
v. （使）失去光泽；使晦暗；玷污
n. 晦暗；污渍
words.ex: The silver spoon will tarnish if not cleaned.
words.ex_cn: 如果银勺不清洗，就会变暗。
words.en: If you say that something tarnishes someone's reputation or image, you mean that it causes people to have a worse opinion of them than they would otherwise have had.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.ex: The journalist wrote a story about the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 记者写了一篇关于地震的文章。
words.en: A journalist is a person whose job is to collect news and write about it for newspapers, magazines, television, or radio.

words.ex: The administration of the school is very organized.
words.ex_cn: 学校的行政管理非常有条理。
words.en: The process or activity of running a business, organization, etc., or the people who run it.

words.ex: He is likely to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能通过考试。
words.en: If you say that something is likely to happen or is likely to be true, you mean that it will probably happen or that it is probably true.

words.tr: adj．零容忍：对某种行为或现象采取严格禁止和严厉打击的政策，不容许任何例外。
words.ex: The school has a zero-tolerance policy for bullying.
words.ex_cn: 学校对欺凌行为采取零容忍政策。
words.en: Zero-tolerance refers to a policy of not tolerating undesirable behavior, such as violence or drug use, at all.

words.ex: He likes cats. In contrast, she prefers dogs.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢猫。相比之下，她更喜欢狗。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.ex: He uses this park exclusively for walking.
words.ex_cn: 他只在这个公园散步。
words.en: If you do something exclusively, you do it only in the way mentioned, and not in any other way.

words.ex: He enjoys recreational activities like swimming and hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢游泳和徒步等娱乐活动。
words.en: Relating to or denoting activity done for enjoyment when one is not working.

words.tr:
adj. 恢复健康的；促使康复的；
n. 有助恢复健康的事物；滋补品；
words.ex: The tea has a restorative effect on tired people.
words.ex_cn: 这种茶对疲劳的人有恢复健康的作用。
words.en: A restorative is something that makes you feel healthier, stronger, or more energetic after you have been feeling ill, weak, or tired.

words.ex: This food contains a harmless additive for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物含有用于调味的无害添加物。
words.en: An additive is a substance which is added in small amounts to something else in order to improve it, preserve it, or make it more effective.

words.ex: He smokes marijuana on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末吸大麻。
words.en: A drug made from the dried leaves and flowers of the hemp plant, which is smoked or eaten to induce euphoria.

words.ex: He used cocaine last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚用了可卡因。
words.en: A drug obtained from the leaves of the coca plant, used as a local anesthetic and also illegally as a stimulant.

words.tr: adj. 合成代谢的；同化的
words.ex: He takes anabolic steroids to build muscle.
words.ex_cn: 他服用合成代谢类固醇来增肌。
words.en: Anabolic refers to the metabolic process that synthesizes complex molecules from simpler ones, often associated with the growth and maintenance of cells.

words.ex: He takes steroid to help his muscles grow.
words.ex_cn: 他服用类固醇来帮助肌肉增长。
words.en: A steroid is a type of organic compound that is biologically active and has a characteristic molecular structure containing four rings of carbon atoms.

words.ex: He will restore the old bike.
words.ex_cn: 他将修复这辆旧自行车。
words.en: To restore something means to bring it back to its original condition or to a state of health, efficiency, or good management.

words.ex: Regular exercise improves your fitness.
words.ex_cn: 规律锻炼能改善你的健康。
words.en: The condition of being physically fit and healthy.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.ex: The consumption of water has increased this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年水的消耗量增加了。
words.en: Consumption is the act of buying and using products.

words.tr:
n. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
v. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
words.ex: The abuse of power led to many problems.
words.ex_cn: 权力的滥用导致了许多问题。
words.en: Abuse is the improper usage or treatment of a thing, often to unfairly or improperly gain benefit. Abuse can come in many forms, such as physical or verbal maltreatment, injury, assault, violation, rape, unjust practices, crimes, or other types of aggression.

words.ex: The rain was a hindrance to the game.
words.ex_cn: 雨水对比赛造成了妨碍。
words.en: A hindrance is a person or thing that makes it difficult for you to do something.

words.tr: n. 公式化；阐述方式；规划；配方
words.ex: The formulation of the equation took hours.
words.ex_cn: 这个公式的推导花了好几个小时。
words.en: The act or process of formulating something, especially a systematic statement of principles or a particular method of preparing something.

words.ex: It is rational to save money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 为未来存钱是合理的。
words.en: Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.ex: The flowers in the garden are artificial.
words.ex_cn: 花园里的花是人造的。
words.en: Made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally, especially as a copy of something natural.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 荷尔蒙控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: A hormone is a chemical substance produced in the body that controls and regulates the activity of certain cells or organs.

words.tr: phrase. 血液兴奋剂；指通过人为增加血液中红细胞数量来提高运动耐力的非法手段，常用于体育作弊
words.ex: He used blood doping to run faster.
words.ex_cn: 他使用血液兴奋剂来跑得更快。
words.en: Blood doping is a method of increasing the number of red blood cells in the bloodstream to improve athletic performance.

words.tr: n. 区别；区分；优等评分；
words.ex: There is a clear distinction between right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 对与错之间有明显的区别。
words.en: A distinction is a difference or contrast between similar things or people.

words.ex: He takes a beta-blocker for his high blood pressure.
words.ex_cn: 他为了控制高血压服用一种β受体阻滞剂。
words.en: A beta-blocker is a type of drug that is used to decrease the heart rate and reduce the force of the heart's contractions, thereby lowering blood pressure and reducing the heart's demand for oxygen.

words.tr: phrase. v. 使……发挥作用；引入……以产生影响
words.ex: They bring teamwork into play to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他们发挥团队合作来解决问题。
words.en: To use or introduce something into a situation, especially a strategy or resource.

words.ex: Doctors must follow medical ethics.
words.ex_cn: 医生必须遵守医学道德规范。
words.en: Ethics are moral beliefs and rules about right and wrong.

words.ex: Please act as a guide for the visitors.
words.ex_cn: 请为来访者充当向导。
words.en: To function or serve in a particular role or capacity.

words.ex: The heavy fine is a deterrent to cheating.
words.ex_cn: 高额罚款是一种威慑作弊的力量。
words.en: Something that discourages or is intended to discourage someone from doing something.

words.tr: v. 把…强加给；使遭受；使承受
words.ex: The storm inflicted heavy damage on the village.
words.ex_cn: 风暴给村庄造成了严重破坏。
words.en: If you inflict something unpleasant on someone, you make them suffer it.

words.ex: His argument was unpersuasive.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点缺乏说服力。
words.en: Not able to make you believe that something is true or right.

words.tr: v. 使合法化；使得到法律认可
words.ex: The country plans to legalize marijuana next year.
words.ex_cn: 该国计划明年将大麻合法化。
words.en: To make something legal or acceptable according to the law.

words.ex: He works efficiently to finish his tasks.
words.ex_cn: 他高效地完成任务。
words.en: If you do something efficiently, you do it in a way that wastes no time, money, or energy.

words.tr: v. 贡献；促成；捐献；投稿；
words.ex: He contributes money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr: v. 使个性化；个别地加以考虑
words.ex: The teacher tries to individualize lessons for each student.
words.ex_cn: 老师努力为每个学生个性化课程。
words.en: To individualize something means to make it suitable for the needs and preferences of a particular person.

words.tr: n. 医学化；用医疗的方法处理
words.ex: The medicalization of everyday life is growing.
words.ex_cn: 日常生活的医学化正在增加。
words.en: The process by which human conditions and problems come to be defined and treated as medical conditions, and thus become the subject of medical study, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment.

words.tr:
v. 有益于；有助于；
n. 利益；好处；
words.ex: Exercise benefits your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有益于你的健康。
words.en: A benefit is something that helps you or improves your life in some way.

words.tr:
n. 奖励；报酬；
v. 奖励；回报；
words.ex: He got a reward for winning the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他因赢得比赛而得到了奖励。
words.en: Something given or received in return for a deed or service rendered.

words.ex: The storm caused unprecedented damage.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴造成了前所未有的破坏。
words.en: If something is unprecedented, it has never happened before.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 以…的规模；在…的程度上
words.ex: They built the model on a small scale.
words.ex_cn: 他们按小规模制作了这个模型。
words.en: Used to indicate the scope or extent of something.

words.ex: He values his privacy and doesn't share personal info online.
words.ex_cn: 他重视自己的隐私，不在网上分享个人信息。
words.en: The state or condition of being free from being observed or disturbed by other people.

words.ex: He violated the school rule by using his phone in class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课使用手机，违反了校规。
words.en: If someone violates an agreement, law, or promise, they break it.

words.tr: adj. 强制的；法定的；义务的；
words.ex: Wearing a helmet is mandatory for cyclists.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是强制的。
words.en: If something is mandatory, it is required by law or by a rule or regulation.

words.ex: He is in rehabilitation after his surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他术后正在康复。
words.en: Rehabilitation is the process of helping someone to have a normal, useful life again after they have been very ill or in prison, or the process of returning a building or area to its previous good condition.

words.ex: The math problem is complicated.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题很复杂。
words.en: Involving many different and confusing aspects.

words.ex: The spectator watched the game quietly.
words.ex_cn: 旁观者安静地观看了比赛。
words.en: A spectator is someone who watches an event, show, game, or activity.

words.ex: My parents disapprove of me staying out late.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母不赞成我熬夜到很晚。
words.en: If you disapprove of something or someone, you feel or show that you do not like them or do not approve of them.

words.ex: The detective uncovered the truth.
words.ex_cn: 侦探揭开了真相。
words.en: To uncover something means to remove the cover from it or to reveal it by investigation or inquiry.

words.ex: He felt psychological stress before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到心理压力。
words.en: Relating to the mental and emotional state of a person.

words.ex: The lab uses biotechnological methods to grow plants.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验室使用生物技术方法来培育植物。
words.en: Relating to biotechnology, the exploitation of biological processes for industrial and other purposes.

words.ex: The loud music was a distraction while I tried to study.
words.ex_cn: 当我试图学习时，大声的音乐让我分心。
words.en: Something that makes it difficult for you to concentrate on what you are doing.

words.ex: The scientist studied genetic traits in plants.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究了植物的基因特征。
words.en: relating to genes or heredity

words.tr: adv. 不加批评地；不加辨别地
words.ex: She accepted the offer uncritically.
words.ex_cn: 她不加批评地接受了提议。
words.en: If someone accepts something uncritically, they accept it without questioning or examining it carefully.

words.ex: A problem arose during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议中出现了一个问题。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises, it begins to exist or people start to become aware of it.

words.ex: He eats as much as his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他吃得和他兄弟一样多。
words.en: You use 'as much as' to say that something is true to the same extent as something else.

words.ex: The child imitates her mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿她妈妈的声音。
words.en: If you imitate someone, you copy what they do or produce.

words.ex: The team is made up of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something is made up of particular things or people, it consists of those things or people.

words.tr:
v. 咕哝；（猪等）打呼噜
n. 咕哝；呼噜声
words.ex: He grunted when he lifted the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬起沉重的箱子时咕哝了一声。
words.en: To make a low, short guttural sound, typically to express dissatisfaction or effort.

words.tr:
v. 呻吟；呼啸；抱怨
n. 呻吟声；萧萧声；抱怨
words.ex: He moans when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 他累了的时候会呻吟。
words.en: If you moan, you make a low sound, usually because you are unhappy or in pain.

words.ex: The bang woke me up at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 那声巨响在午夜把我吵醒了。
words.en: A bang is a sudden loud noise such as the noise of an explosion.

words.ex: The rhythm of the music made everyone dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐的节奏让所有人都跳起了舞。
words.en: A rhythm is a regular series of sounds or movements.

words.tr:
v. 打；敲打；击败；
n. 一击；跳动；
words.ex: He beat the drum loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他用力敲打鼓。
words.en: To defeat someone in a game, competition, election, or battle; to hit someone or something many times with your hand, a stick, etc.

words.tr:
n. 曲调；调子；
v. 调整；调音；
words.ex: He hummed a happy tune while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他走路时哼着一首欢快的曲调。
words.en: A tune is a series of musical notes that are pleasant to listen to. It can also refer to adjusting something so that it works or looks better.

words.tr:
v. 吹；打击；
n. 打击；
words.ex: The wind blows the leaves away.
words.ex_cn: 风吹走了树叶。
words.en: To move air or gas forcefully; to strike something with force.

words.tr:
n. 信号；
v. 用信号通知；
words.ex: The traffic light is a signal to stop.
words.ex_cn: 交通灯是一个停止的信号。
words.en: A signal is a gesture, sound, or action which is intended to give a particular message to the person who sees or hears it.

words.ex: The wedding ceremony was beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼仪式很美丽。
words.en: A ceremony is a formal event held on special occasions such as weddings, graduations, or official functions, often involving traditional or religious rituals.

words.tr:
n. 荣誉；荣幸；尊敬；
v. 尊敬；给予荣誉；履行；
words.ex: He received an honor for his brave actions.
words.ex_cn: 他因勇敢的行为获得了荣誉。
words.en: Honor is a quality that combines respect, pride, and honesty. A person who has honor is someone who is admired and respected because of his or her integrity and ethical behavior.

words.tr: n. 治疗；疗癒；愈合； v. “heal”的现在分词；
words.ex: The healing of the wound took two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 伤口的治疗花了两周时间。
words.en: The process of becoming healthy again, especially after a cut or other injury, or of making someone healthy again.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.ex: He plays the drum, a type of percussion.
words.ex_cn: 他演奏鼓，一种打击乐器。
words.en: Percussion refers to musical instruments that are played by being struck or shaken, such as drums, cymbals, or tambourines. It can also refer to the act of striking or hitting something.

words.ex: I met my old friend by chance at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市碰巧遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: If something happens by chance, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.ex: The tree has a hollow trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的树干是中空的。
words.en: If something is hollow, it has an empty space inside it.

words.tr:
n. 拨浪鼓；嘎嘎声；咔嗒声
v. 发出格格声；使紧张不安；喋喋不休
words.ex: The baby laughed while shaking the rattle.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝摇着拨浪鼓笑了。
words.en: If something rattles or if you rattle it, it makes short sharp knocking sounds as it moves or shakes.

words.ex: He accidentally dropped his phone on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心把手机掉在地上了。
words.en: If something happens accidentally, it happens by chance or without being planned.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.ex: He painted a gourd for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 他为节日画了一个葫芦。
words.en: A gourd is a large fruit with a hard skin, often used for decoration or as a container.

words.tr: adj. 锋利的；骤变的；灵敏的；尖刻的；
words.ex: The knife is sharp enough to cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀足够锋利，可以切纸。
words.en: Having a thin edge or a fine point that is capable of cutting or piercing; keen.

words.ex: He plays a stringed instrument like a violin.
words.ex_cn: 他演奏一种弦乐器，比如小提琴。
words.en: Having strings or equipped with strings, especially referring to musical instruments.

words.tr: n. 刮刀; 刮的人; 平土机; 铲土机
words.ex: He uses a scraper to clean the window.
words.ex_cn: 他用刮刀清理窗户。
words.en: A scraper is a tool used for scraping, especially for removing something from a surface.

words.tr: n. 采摘者；采集者；采摘工具
words.ex: He is the picker for the basketball team.
words.ex_cn: 他是篮球队的挑选者。
words.en: A picker is a person or machine that picks or selects things, especially fruits or vegetables.

words.tr:
n. 小提琴；骗局
v. 摆弄；虚度时光；拉小提琴；篡改
words.ex: He bought a fiddle at the music shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐店买了一把小提琴。
words.en: A fiddle is a musical instrument with strings that you play with a bow. It is the same as a violin.

words.ex: They made rope from hemp.
words.ex_cn: 他们用大麻纤维制作绳子。
words.en: Hemp is a plant from the cannabis family, cultivated for its fiber, seeds, and oil. It is used in a variety of products, including textiles, paper, and biodegradable plastics.

words.ex: The intestine helps digest food.
words.ex_cn: 肠道帮助消化食物。
words.en: The part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus.

words.ex: The ram broke down the wooden door.
words.ex_cn: 撞击装置撞碎了木门。
words.en: A ram is an adult male sheep. As a verb, it means to force something into a place or to hit something with great force.

words.ex: The table is made from wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是用木头做的。
words.en: Created or produced using a particular material or substance as the main component.

words.ex: He plays the flute every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上吹长笛。
words.en: A flute is a musical instrument of the woodwind family. You play it by blowing over a hole at one end while holding it sideways.

words.ex: He plays the flute, a woodwind instrument.
words.ex_cn: 他吹奏长笛，一种木管乐器。
words.en: Woodwind instruments are a family of musical instruments within the more general category of wind instruments. Common examples include flute, clarinet, oboe, bassoon, and saxophone.

words.ex: He broke the vase on purpose.
words.ex_cn: 他故意打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If you do something on purpose, you do it intentionally, not by accident.

words.ex: The reed grows near the river.
words.ex_cn: 芦苇长在河边。
words.en: A reed is a tall, thin plant that grows in water or marshy ground.

words.ex: The surgeon repaired the torn tendon in the athlete's leg.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了运动员腿上的撕裂肌腱。
words.en: A tendon is a tough band of fibrous connective tissue that usually connects muscle to bone and is capable of withstanding tension.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.ex: He makes a living by selling vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他靠卖蔬菜谋生。
words.en: To earn enough money to support oneself.

words.tr:
n. 避难所；庇护所；
v. 庇护；遮蔽；
words.ex: The refugees found shelter in a small building.
words.ex_cn: 难民们在一个小建筑里找到了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.ex: The bard sang a song about love and war.
words.ex_cn: 这位吟游诗人唱了一首关于爱情与战争的歌。
words.en: A bard is a poet, traditionally one who recites epic poems and is associated with a particular oral tradition.

words.tr: phrase. 宁愿……也不……（用于表达偏好或选择）
words.ex: I would rather walk than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: Used to indicate a preference for one thing over another.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: He lives apart from the city noise.
words.ex_cn: 他住在远离城市喧嚣的地方。
words.en: You use apart from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.ex: He felt deep grief after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到深深的悲痛。
words.en: Intense sorrow, especially caused by someone's death.

words.tr: 短语动词. 开始掌权；上台执政
words.ex: The new leader came into power last year.
words.ex_cn: 这位新领导人去年上台执政。
words.en: To assume a position of authority or control, especially in government.

words.tr: phrase. 变得活跃起来；变得生动有趣；苏醒过来
words.ex: The city comes alive at night.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市在夜晚变得热闹起来。
words.en: To become lively or animated; to become active or full of life.

words.ex: He is a composer who writes music for movies.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位为电影作曲的作曲家。
words.en: A composer is a person who writes music, especially classical music.

words.ex: The bar graph shows the number of students in each class.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形图显示了每个班级的学生人数。
words.en: A bar graph is a chart that uses bars to show comparisons among categories. The bars can be either horizontal or vertical.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.tr: n. （Beatles）披头士乐队（英国摇滚乐队, The Beatles）; n. （Beatle...
words.ex: The Beatles sang many popular songs in the 1960s.
words.ex_cn: 披头士乐队在20世纪60年代演唱了许多流行歌曲。
words.en: The Beatles were an English rock band formed in Liverpool in 1960. With members John Lennon, Paul McCartney, George Harrison, and Ringo Starr, they became widely regarded as the foremost and most influential music band in history.

words.ex: We should keep in touch even after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 我们毕业后也应该保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone, especially after not seeing them for a period of time.

words.ex: He talked his sister into joining the club.
words.ex_cn: 他说服了他妹妹加入这个俱乐部。
words.en: To persuade someone to do something.

words.ex: He caught a big bass in the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他在湖里钓到了一条大鲈鱼。
words.en: The lowest adult male singing voice; or the musical part that is the lowest in pitch.

words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.ex: I will arrange a meeting for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我将为明天安排一次会议。
words.en: If you arrange an event or meeting, you make plans for it to happen.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.ex: He will take over the business next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将接管这家企业。
words.en: To take control of something, especially a company, by buying a majority of its shares or by getting a position of power within it.

words.ex: He wears a fab jacket to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件很棒的夹克去参加派对。
words.en: If you say that something is fab, you are emphasizing that you think it is very good.

words.tr:
n. 释放；发布；
v. 释放；发布；
words.ex: The release of the prisoner made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯的释放让每个人都高兴。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or to allow it to be free, or to make something available to the public.

words.ex: The teacher showed a chart of temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一张温度图表。
words.en: A chart is a graphical representation of data, in which the data is represented by symbols, such as bars in a bar chart, lines in a line chart, or slices in a pie chart.

words.ex: He discovered an unheard song from the 1980s.
words.ex_cn: 他发现了一首上世纪80年代不为人知的歌曲。
words.en: If you say that something is unheard, you mean that it is not known about or heard of by many people.

words.ex: The king was assassinated by a secret group.
words.ex_cn: 国王被一个秘密组织刺杀。
words.en: To assassinate someone means to murder them, especially for political reasons or for payment.

words.tr: adv. 绝望地；拼命地；不顾一切地；极度地
words.ex: He is desperately trying to find his lost dog.
words.ex_cn: 他正在拼命寻找他丢失的狗。
words.en: In a way that shows a lack of hope and a willingness to do anything to change a situation, often involving a lot of effort or risk.

words.ex: The medicine helps reduce inhibition of the immune system.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物有助于抑制免疫系统的抑制。
words.en: Inhibition is a feeling that makes one self-conscious and unable to act in a relaxed and natural way.

words.tr: adj. 广大的；广阔的；广泛的；大量的；
words.ex: He has extensive knowledge of history.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有广博的历史知识。
words.en: Something that is extensive covers a wide area or includes a lot of things.

words.tr: n. 旅游；游览；巡回活动；
words.ex: We went on a tour of Paris last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去巴黎旅游了。
words.en: A tour is a journey in which you visit several places that interest you, especially on holiday.

words.ex: The ad is on a big billboard near the road.
words.ex_cn: 广告牌在路边的大广告牌上。
words.en: A billboard is a large outdoor board for displaying advertisements.

words.ex: The concert tickets sold out in one hour.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会的票在一小时内就卖光了。
words.en: To sell all of the available items or tickets for an event, so that there are no more left for people to buy.

words.ex: The teacher makes comments on my homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师对我作业做出评论。
words.en: To express opinions or observations about something.

words.tr: adj. 反对现有权力结构的，反对权威当局的
words.ex: He has anti-establishment views and criticizes the government.
words.ex_cn: 他有反体制的观点，并批评政府。
words.en: Opposed to or against the established social, political, or economic order.

words.ex: The concept of freedom is important in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 自由这个观念在许多国家都很重要。
words.en: A concept is an idea or abstract principle.

words.ex: The theme of the essay is friendship.
words.ex_cn: 这篇作文的题目是友谊。
words.en: The subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing, or work of art.

words.ex: He had to endure the cold winter without a coat.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不在没有外套的情况下忍受寒冷的冬天。
words.en: To endure means to suffer something difficult, unpleasant, or painful, or to continue to exist for a long time.

words.tr:
n. 压力；（动植物的）品种；
v. 竭力；
words.ex: The job gave him a lot of strain.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作给他带来了很大的压力。
words.en: To strain means to make a great effort to do something, to pull or stretch something tightly, or to injure a muscle by stretching it too much.

words.ex: He is a long-time friend of mine.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的老朋友。
words.en: Having existed or continued for a long period of time.

words.tr:
n. 服药过量；嗑药过量；过量
v. （使）服药过量；过量…
words.ex: He took an overdose of pills and went to hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他服用了过量的药片，被送到了医院。
words.en: An overdose is the taking of too much of a drug, which can cause serious harm or death.

words.ex: The photographer took pictures of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这位摄影家拍了日落的照片。
words.en: A photographer is a person who takes photographs, especially as a job.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细检查并分类；整理（物品、文件等）
words.ex: He needs to sort through the papers on his desk.
words.ex_cn: 他需要整理桌上的文件。
words.en: To sort through something means to look at a number of things in a group and decide which ones you want or need, and which ones you do not.

words.ex: He bought a raincoat, and it rained ironically the next day.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一件雨衣，讽刺的是，第二天就下雨了。
words.en: In a way that is contrary to what is expected and is therefore amusing or strange.

words.tr: n. 留声机（等于 gramophone）；（外）祖母；老太太（等于 grandmother）
words.ex: She won a grammy for her best song.
words.ex_cn: 她因最好的歌曲赢得了格莱美奖。
words.en: A Grammy is an award presented by the Recording Academy to recognize outstanding achievement in the music industry.

words.tr: adj. 蜿蜒的； v. “wind”的现在分词；
words.ex: The winding road goes through the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条蜿蜒的道路穿过山脉。
words.en: A winding path, road, river, etc. repeatedly turns in different directions.

words.tr:
n. 谣言
v. 谣传
words.ex: The rumor spread quickly that the school would close.
words.ex_cn: 学校即将关闭的谣言迅速传播开来。
words.en: A rumor is a story or piece of information that may or may not be true, but that people are talking about.

words.ex: The family had a reunion last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 这家人上个星期天举行了团聚。
words.en: A reunion is a gathering of people who have been separated, especially members of a family or old friends, coming together again.

words.ex: The child let out a loud shriek when she saw the spider.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子看到蜘蛛时，发出了一声大叫。
words.en: If someone shrieks, they make a short, very loud cry, for example because they are suddenly surprised, are in pain, or are laughing.

words.ex: The fire became uncontrollable after the wind blew strongly.
words.ex_cn: 风猛烈吹起后，火势变得无法控制。
words.en: If something is uncontrollable, it cannot be controlled or managed.

words.ex: The mob broke the windows and shouted loudly.
words.ex_cn: 乌合之众砸了窗户并大声喊叫。
words.en: A mob is a large crowd of people, especially one that is disorderly and intent on causing trouble or violence.

words.ex: He worked hard to attain his goals.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以达到他的目标。
words.en: If you attain something, you gain it or achieve it, often after a lot of effort.

words.tr: adj. 持久的；恒久的； v. 持续；“last”的现在分词；
words.ex: The friendship between them is lasting.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的友谊是持久的。
words.en: Something that is lasting continues to exist or have an effect for a very long time.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.w: keep an ear to the ground
words.tr: phrase. 保持警觉；留意最新动态；随时掌握消息
words.ex: He keeps an ear to the ground to hear about job openings.
words.ex_cn: 他留心打听工作机会。
words.en: To stay informed about new developments or trends.

words.ex: He makes occasional visits to his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他偶尔去看望祖父母。
words.en: Occasional means happening or done sometimes, but not regularly or often.

words.ex: He loves snowboarding in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在山上滑雪板。
words.en: Snowboarding is a winter sport that involves descending a slope that is covered with snow while standing on a snowboard, a flat board with bindings for the rider's feet.

words.ex: He wears clean underclothing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿干净的内衣。
words.en: Clothing worn next to the skin, beneath outer garments.

words.tr: n. 护目镜；风镜；游泳镜；“goggle”的复数；
words.ex: He wears goggles to protect his eyes while swimming.
words.ex_cn: 他游泳时戴护目镜保护眼睛。
words.en: Goggles are a type of protective eyewear that usually enclose or protect the area surrounding the eye in order to prevent particulates, water or chemicals from striking the eyes.

words.tr: phrase. 打算做；有意做；故意做
words.ex: I didn't mean to break your toy.
words.ex_cn: 我不是故意弄坏你的玩具的。
words.en: If you mean to do something, you intend to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；陷入；染上（坏习惯）
words.ex: He wants to get into a good university.
words.ex_cn: 他想进入一所好大学。
words.en: To enter or become involved in a particular activity, situation, or state.

words.ex: The farmer rides his ass to the market.
words.ex_cn: 农夫骑着他的驴去市场。
words.en: An ass is a donkey, a domesticated animal of the horse family, or a foolish or stupid person.

words.tr: adj. （Texan）德克萨斯州的；德克萨斯州人的; n. （Texan）德克萨斯州人; n. （...
words.ex: The texan loves to eat barbecue.
words.ex_cn: 这位得克萨斯人喜欢吃烧烤。
words.en: A Texan is a person from the U.S. state of Texas.

words.ex: The cat is underneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If one thing is underneath another, it is directly under it, often so that it is hidden by it.

words.ex: This room is relatively small.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间相对较小。
words.en: In comparison with other similar things or with what you expect.

words.tr: adj. 脾气暴躁的；坏脾气的
words.ex: He is ill-tempered and shouts at everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他脾气不好，对每个人大喊大叫。
words.en: If you describe someone as ill-tempered, you mean they are angry or hostile, and you may be suggesting that they are often like this.

words.ex: The company made a statement about the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 公司就新政策发布了一项声明。
words.en: A statement is something that you say or write which gives information in a formal or definite way.

words.ex: The room has good ventilation through the windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间通过窗户有良好的通风。
words.en: The provision of fresh air to a room, building, etc., or the system that does this.

words.tr: phrase. 想到；想起；有...的看法
words.ex: I think of my mom when I eat cookies.
words.ex_cn: 当我吃饼干时，我想起我的妈妈。
words.en: To have a particular idea or opinion about something or someone; to consider something or someone in a particular way.

words.ex: The old house looks ugly with broken windows.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子有破窗户，看起来很丑陋。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is ugly, you mean that they are very unattractive and unpleasant to look at.

words.ex: This jacket is waterproof.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是防水的。
words.en: Something that is waterproof does not let water pass through it.

words.tr:
n. 预测；预报；
v. 预测；预报；
words.ex: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: If you forecast future events, you say what you think is going to happen in the future.

words.tr:
n. 长裤子；短内裤； “pant”的复数
v. 喘气；喘息；“pant”的第三人称单数
words.ex: He is wearing blue pants.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着蓝色的裤子。
words.en: Pants are a piece of clothing that covers the body from the waist to the ankles and divides into two parts to cover each leg separately.

words.ex: He is absolutely sure about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对确定这个答案。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is completely true or correct.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.tr:
adj. 立即的；即时的；
n. 瞬间；立即；
words.ex: He wants an instant answer.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一个立即的回答。
words.en: An instant is a very short period of time, or a particular point in time.

words.tr: phrase. 使用；接近；可以利用
words.ex: Students have access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后可以使用图书馆。
words.en: To have the right or opportunity to use or see something.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.tr: phrase. 碾过；溢出；匆匆浏览；超过（时间、数量等）
words.ex: The car ran over a small stone on the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车碾过了路上的一块小石头。
words.en: To hit someone or something with a vehicle and drive over them; to quickly look through or read something; to overflow.

words.tr: adj. 令人尴尬的；令人为难的； v. “embarrass”的现在分词；
words.ex: It was embarrassing when I tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 我在大家面前绊倒了，很尴尬。
words.en: Something that is embarrassing makes you feel shy or ashamed.

words.ex: He packed his belongings before moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他在搬去新城市前收拾好了自己的所有物。
words.en: Your belongings are the things that you own, especially things that are small enough to be carried.

words.tr: phrase. v. 减损；削弱（某人或某事物的价值、重要性或效果）
words.ex: The noise did not take away from her enjoyment of the concert.
words.ex_cn: 噪音并没有影响她对音乐会的享受。
words.en: To reduce the value, quality, or enjoyment of something.

words.ex: He underestimated the difficulty of the test.
words.ex_cn: 他低估了考试的难度。
words.en: If you underestimate something, you do not realize how large, great, or serious it is.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.tr: n. 鼻涕（不礼貌用语）；<非正式>傲慢无礼的人 ；<非正式>可鄙的人，无用的人
words.ex: The baby has a runny nose and lots of snot.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿流鼻涕，有很多鼻涕。
words.en: Snot is the mucus that is produced in your nose.

words.tr:
n. 垫；爪垫；便笺簿
v. 放轻脚步走
words.ex: She put a pad on the chair for comfort.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个垫子以增加舒适感。
words.en: A pad is a flat piece of material that is used to protect something, to make something more comfortable, or to absorb liquid.

words.tr:
v. 渗出；流出；分泌出
n. 软泥；淤泥；泥浆
words.ex: Mud is oozing from the hole.
words.ex_cn: 泥巴正从洞里渗出来。
words.en: If a liquid oozes from something or if something oozes a liquid, the liquid flows from it slowly and in small quantities.

words.tr: phrase. 使注意力集中于；专注于
words.ex: He tries to keep his attention on the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他努力把注意力集中在老师身上。
words.en: To maintain focus or concentration on something.

words.tr: n. （大学一年级男生或儿童等戴的）无檐小便帽
words.ex: He wears a beanie in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天戴一顶毛线帽。
words.en: A beanie is a small, round, close-fitting hat, usually made of wool, that is worn on the head to keep it warm.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘和沙发相配。
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.ex: The fluorescent lamp lights up the room quickly.
words.ex_cn: 荧光灯很快照亮了房间。
words.en: Fluorescent substances produce bright light of a particular color when they are exposed to light of a different wavelength.

words.tr: n. 笨蛋；呆子；阴茎; n. （Dork）人名；（英）多克
words.ex: He is a dork who loves math books.
words.ex_cn: 他是个喜欢数学书的书呆子。
words.en: If you call someone a dork, you think they are stupid or ridiculous, especially because they dress or behave in a way that is not fashionable.

words.ex: She has excellent night vision.
words.ex_cn: 她有很好的夜视能力。
words.en: Vision is the ability to see, the area that you can see, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc. could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way, or an experience in which you see something that is not really there.

words.ex: The vase remained intact after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 花瓶从高处摔下后依然完整无缺。
words.en: Something that is intact is complete and has not been damaged or changed.

words.tr:
n. 图画；照片；
v. 想象；
words.ex: The child drew a picture of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting. It can also refer to a movie or a description that creates a mental image.

words.tr: n. 镇静剂；镇定剂；止痛药
words.ex: The doctor gave him a tranquilizer to calm down.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一种镇静剂来让他平静下来。
words.en: A tranquilizer is a drug used to reduce anxiety or tension.

words.tr:
v. （使）突然移动；快速投掷；
n. 镖；
words.ex: The cat darted across the room.
words.ex_cn: 猫突然冲过房间。
words.en: A dart is a small, narrow object with a sharp point which can be thrown or shot. It can also mean to move suddenly and quickly in a particular direction.

words.ex: An icicle hangs from the roof.
words.ex_cn: 一个冰锥挂在屋顶上。
words.en: An icicle is a pointed piece of ice that is formed when dripping water freezes, typically hanging from a surface.

words.tr: n. 摩押（古代中东的一个王国，位于死海东南）
words.ex: He ate a moab cookie for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一块摩阿布饼干。
words.en: An ancient kingdom located in the Middle East, east of the Dead Sea, mentioned in the Bible.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全面的；总体的；
adv. 总计；大致上；
words.ex: The overall cost is too high.
words.ex_cn: 总成本太高了。
words.en: You use overall to indicate that you are talking about a situation in general or about the whole of something.

words.ex: The paint has an underlayer to help it stick better.
words.ex_cn: 这种油漆有一层底漆，以帮助它更好地附着。
words.en: A layer that is situated beneath another layer.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.ex: He wears a mitten to keep his hand warm.
words.ex_cn: 他戴一只连指手套来暖手。
words.en: A mitten is a glove that has one section for the thumb and another section for all four fingers together, used to keep the hands warm in cold weather.

words.ex: Keep in mind that the bus leaves at 6 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 记住，公交车六点发车。
words.en: To remember or not forget something.

words.ex: The victim cried for help.
words.ex_cn: 受害者呼救。
words.en: A victim is someone who has been harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event or action.

words.ex: Too much sugar can result in health problems.
words.ex_cn: 过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: The soil has too much moisture.
words.ex_cn: 土壤中有太多湿气。
words.en: Moisture is tiny drops of water in the air, on a surface, or in a substance, that make it feel wet.

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.ex: This necklace is precious to her.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链对她来说很珍贵。
words.en: If you say that something such as a resource is precious, you mean that it is valuable and should not be wasted or used badly.

words.tr:
n. 报复；报仇
v. 报复
words.ex: He wanted revenge for his brother's death.
words.ex_cn: 他想为他兄弟的死报仇。
words.en: Revenge involves hurting or punishing someone who has hurt or harmed you.

words.ex: He used a roller to flatten the dirt.
words.ex_cn: 他用滚筒把泥土压平。
words.en: To flatten something means to make it flat or flatter, or to knock it down to the ground.

words.tr: n. 狗; v. 凸出，膨胀
words.ex: The pooch is sleeping on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗正在地板上睡觉。
words.en: A pooch is a dog, especially a mongrel.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；跟随；进步；（催促）赶快
words.ex: I didn't see him, but he came along later.
words.ex_cn: 我没看到他，但他后来出现了。
words.en: To appear or arrive, often unexpectedly; to make progress or improve.

words.ex: The new shelf does not fit into the corner.
words.ex_cn: 这个新架子放不进角落里。
words.en: If you fit into a group or situation, you seem to belong there because you are similar to the other people involved.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his hip.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤到了臀部。
words.en: The hip is the area on each side of the body below the waist and above the thigh.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.tr: n. 企业家；创业者；承包人；
words.ex: He is an entrepreneur who started a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创办了小型咖啡店的企业家。
words.en: An entrepreneur is a person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on greater than normal financial risks in order to do so.

words.ex: Steve Jobs is the founder of Apple.
words.ex_cn: 史蒂夫·乔布斯是苹果公司的创办者。
words.en: A founder is someone who establishes an organization, company, or institution. As a verb, it means to fail or collapse, especially in terms of a plan or a ship sinking.

words.tr: adj. 价值（或花费）达数百万的
words.ex: He is a multimillionaire who owns a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位拥有大公司的亿万富翁。
words.en: A multimillion amount of money is an amount that is several million or more.

words.tr: adj. 女子般的；有女子气质的；女子特有的
words.ex: She showed a womanly concern for her friend's well-being.
words.ex_cn: 她表现出对朋友福祉的女人特有的关心。
words.en: Having qualities or characteristics traditionally associated with women.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.ex: The manufacturer makes cars in this factory.
words.ex_cn: 这家制造商在这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A manufacturer is a person or company that produces goods in large quantities, especially in a factory.

words.ex: He dreamt of flying like a bird.
words.ex_cn: 他梦见自己像鸟一样飞翔。
words.en: To think about something that you would like to happen or achieve.

words.tr: phrase. 整形外科医生；整容外科医生
words.ex: He went to a plastic surgeon to fix his nose.
words.ex_cn: 他去找整形外科医生修复鼻子。
words.en: A plastic surgeon is a doctor who performs operations to repair or replace skin, bone, and other tissues, or to change the shape of parts of the body.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call on my grandma this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我将去拜访我的奶奶。
words.en: To visit someone; to formally ask or request someone to do something.

words.tr:
v. 吸引；诱惑；引诱
n. 诱惑；诱饵；吸引力
words.ex: The bright colors lure the birds to the feeder.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引鸟类来到喂食器。
words.en: If you lure someone, you tempt them to do something or to go somewhere, especially by offering some form of reward.

words.tr: n. 发电厂；精力旺盛的人；强大的集团（或组织）
words.ex: The old powerhouse still provides electricity for the town.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧发电厂仍为这个城镇供电。
words.en: A powerhouse is an organization or country that is very strong or important, or a person who is very energetic.

words.ex: The company plans to recruit new staff next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划下个月招聘新员工。
words.en: To recruit means to enlist someone in the armed forces or to persuade someone to join a company, organization, or group.

words.tr: n. 粗斜纹棉布；劳动布；牛仔布
words.ex: He wears blue denim jeans every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿蓝色牛仔裤。
words.en: Denim is a kind of cotton fabric, typically blue, used for making jeans, jackets, and other clothing.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.tr:
v. 奉承；讨好
adj. 更平坦的；更扁平的；“flat”的比较级
adv. 更平直地；更直截了当地；“flat”的比较级
words.ex: He flatters his boss to get a raise.
words.ex_cn: 他奉承老板以获得加薪。
words.en: If someone flatters you, they praise you in an exaggerated way that may be sincere or may be intended to persuade you to do something.

words.ex: He needs time for recovery after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他手术后需要时间恢复。
words.en: The process of becoming well again after an illness or injury, or the process of returning to a normal condition after a period of difficulty.

words.ex: She applied hair gel to style her hair.
words.ex_cn: 她用了发胶来造型头发。
words.en: A gel is a thick, jelly-like substance, especially one used to style hair.

words.tr:
v. 伸展；延伸；持续；
n. 一段；伸展；
words.ex: He stretches his arms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上伸展手臂。
words.en: To stretch is to extend your body or a part of your body to its full length, or to extend something else to its full length or beyond its normal limits.

words.tr: n. 织物；（建筑物的）结构；
words.ex: The dress is made of soft fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是由柔软的织物制成的。
words.en: Fabric refers to cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. It can also refer to the basic structure of a building or a system.

words.tr:
n. 补锅匠
v. 小修；小补；摆弄
words.ex: He is a tinker who fixes old pots and pans.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名补锅匠，修理旧锅旧盆。
words.en: If you tinker with something, you make some small changes to it in an attempt to improve it or repair it.

words.tr: n. 莱卡，人造弹性纤维品牌
words.ex: The swimsuit is made of a combination of nylon and lycra for extra flexibility.
words.ex_cn: 这件泳衣是由尼龙和莱卡混合制成，以增加弹性。
words.en: Lycra is a type of synthetic fiber known for its exceptional elasticity. It is often used in the manufacture of clothing, especially in sportswear and dance costumes, due to its ability to stretch and then return to its original shape.

words.ex: He sculpted a statue from clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏土雕刻了一座雕像。
words.en: To sculpt means to create or represent something by carving, casting, or other shaping techniques.

words.ex: He pointed at his derrière and laughed.
words.ex_cn: 他指着自己的臀部笑了。
words.en: The part of the body that you sit on; the buttocks.

words.ex: She gave me a book.
words.ex_cn: 她给了我一本书。
words.en: To freely transfer the possession of something to someone; to cause or allow someone to have something.

words.ex: He got a patent for his new invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的新发明获得了专利。
words.en: A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.

words.tr:
n. 首次露面；初次登场
v. 初次登场；首次推出
words.ex: He made his debut on stage last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚在舞台上首次登台。
words.en: The debut of a performer or sports player is their first public performance, appearance, or recording.

words.ex: The vendor sells fresh fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这个商贩在市场卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A vendor is a person or company that sells goods or services.

words.ex: He heard about the restaurant by word of mouth.
words.ex_cn: 他通过口口相传知道了这家餐厅。
words.en: Information that is passed from person to person by oral communication.

words.ex: Pre-school children love to play.
words.ex_cn: 学龄前的孩子喜欢玩耍。
words.en: Pre is a prefix which means before.

words.ex: The bees made a loud buzz near the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在花附近发出嗡嗡声。
words.en: To make a low, continuous, humming or sibilant sound, like that made by bees or flies.

words.ex: She bought a warm wrap for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一件保暖的包裹（披肩）过冬。
words.en: To cover or enclose something in paper, cloth, or other material.

words.ex: He uses a tape measure to find the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用卷尺测量桌子的长度。
words.en: A tape measure is a flexible ruler used to measure size or distance. It consists of a ribbon of cloth, plastic, fiberglass, or metal strip with linear-measurement markings.

words.tr: v. 兜售；招徕；吹捧；倒卖（高价票）
words.ex: He touts the new phone as the best on the market.
words.ex_cn: 他吹捧这款新手机是市场上最好的。
words.en: If someone touts something, they try to sell it or convince people that it is good, especially in an aggressive or exaggerated way.

words.tr: n. 售货亭；报刊亭；公用电话亭
words.ex: He bought a ticket from the kiosk.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动售票机买了一张票。
words.en: A kiosk is a small open-fronted hut or cubicle from which newspapers, refreshments, tickets, etc., are sold.

words.ex: The division of the cake was fair.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的划分是公平的。
words.en: The act or process of dividing something into parts or the state of being divided.

words.ex: He bought equity in a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了一家科技公司的股票。
words.en: Equity is the quality of being fair and impartial.

words.tr: phrase. 涉及；专心； 卷入
words.ex: He is involved in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他参与了学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To be included or participate in something, especially something that requires a lot of time or effort.

words.ex: The new bridge is still on the drawing board.
words.ex_cn: 这座新桥还在设计阶段。
words.en: In the planning or design stage; not yet implemented or built.

words.ex: She wears leggings to the gym every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天穿紧身裤去健身房。
words.en: Leggings are tight-fitting stretch pants, typically worn by women or girls.

words.tr:
n. 膨胀；凸出部分；暴涨
v. 膨胀；凸出；急增
words.ex: The balloon begins to bulge when filled with air.
words.ex_cn: 气球充气时开始鼓起来。
words.en: If something bulges, it sticks out or swells in a rounded shape.

words.ex: She wears a bra every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天穿胸衣。
words.en: A bra is a piece of underwear that women wear to support their breasts.

words.tr:
n. 母亲身份；
adj. 产妇的；
words.ex: She enjoys her maternity after giving birth to her first child.
words.ex_cn: 她在生下第一个孩子后享受做母亲的身份。
words.en: Maternity refers to the state of being a mother or the period during which a woman is pregnant or has recently given birth.

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.tr:
v. 把…塞进狭窄的空间；把…藏入
n. 褶皱；零食
words.ex: He tucked the letter into his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他把信塞进了口袋里。
words.en: If you tuck something somewhere, you put it there so that it is safe, comfortable, or neat.

words.ex: Lying has serious consequences.
words.ex_cn: 撒谎会有严重的后果。
words.en: A consequence is a result or effect of an action or condition.

words.ex: The concert was fabulous!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太棒了！
words.en: If you describe something as fabulous, you are emphasizing that you like it a lot or think that it is very good.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.ex: The famous artist took her young protege under her wing.
words.ex_cn: 这位著名艺术家收这位年轻后辈为徒。
words.en: A protégé is a person who is guided and supported by an older and more experienced or influential person.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.tr:
n. 尽力；尝试；
v. 尽力；奋力；
words.ex: His endeavor to finish the project took all his energy.
words.ex_cn: 他为完成这个项目付出了全部努力。
words.en: An endeavor is an attempt to do something, especially something new or original.

words.tr:
n. 缺乏；短缺；
v. 缺乏；短缺；
words.ex: There is a lack of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.tr: n. 音调；语气；强健状况；色调；氛围；
words.ex: His tone sounded angry.
words.ex_cn: 他的音调听起来很生气。
words.en: The tone of a sound is its particular quality. In music, tone refers to the pitch of a note. In art, tone refers to the lightness or darkness of a color. In speech, tone refers to the quality of the voice which expresses the speaker's feelings or intentions.

words.ex: He excels in math.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长数学。
words.en: To be exceptionally good at or proficient in an activity or subject.

words.tr: adv. 忠实地；尽职地；顺从地
words.ex: He dutifully does his homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都认真地做作业。
words.en: If you say that someone does something dutifully, you mean that they do it because they have been told to or because they feel it is their duty.

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.tr: adj. 天生的；先天的；天赋的
words.ex: He has an inborn talent for music.
words.ex_cn: 他天生就有音乐才能。
words.en: An inborn quality or ability is one that you have had naturally since birth.

words.ex: I will pick you up at 7 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我晚上七点去接你。
words.en: To collect someone from a place, typically by car.

words.ex: He handed out a flyer about the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他分发了一张关于音乐会的传单。
words.en: A flyer is a small handbill advertising an event or product.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生（或来临）的
words.ex: The upcoming meeting is on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 即将到来的会议在周五。
words.en: An upcoming event is one that is going to happen soon.

words.ex: The child gave a recital of poems at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在学校进行了诗歌朗诵。
words.en: A recital is a performance of music or poetry, usually given by a soloist or a small group.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.ex: He decided to drop out of the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他决定不参加比赛。
words.en: If someone drops out of a school or a course, they leave it before they have finished it.

words.tr: v. 使合格；使具有资格；
words.ex: He studied hard to qualify for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以获得这份工作的资格。
words.en: To qualify means to meet the necessary conditions or standards to be eligible for something or to perform a particular role.

words.ex: His persistence helped him pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他的坚持让他通过了考试。
words.en: Persistence is the determination to do something even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.ex: They play basketball in the gymnasium.
words.ex_cn: 他们在体育馆打篮球。
words.en: A gymnasium is a large room or building with equipment for exercising the body and increasing strength.

words.ex: The firework went off at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 烟花在午夜爆炸了。
words.en: If a device or alarm goes off, it starts to ring loudly or make a loud noise. To leave a place, especially in order to do something. To happen in a particular way. To stop liking someone or something. To explode or fire. To decay or become rotten.

words.tr: phrase. 在舞台上；当众表演；处于公众视线中
words.ex: The actor performed on stage with great confidence.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员在舞台上表演得非常自信。
words.en: When someone is on stage, they are performing in front of an audience.

words.tr:
n. 皱纹
v. 起皱纹；弄皱…
words.ex: He has a deep wrinkle on his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他的额头上有一道深深的皱纹。
words.en: A wrinkle is a small line or fold in something, especially fabric or the skin.

words.ex: He uses an eggbeater to mix the eggs.
words.ex_cn: 他用打蛋器搅拌鸡蛋。
words.en: A kitchen utensil used for beating eggs or whipping cream, typically consisting of a handle attached to a series of wire loops.

words.tr: phrase. 装扮；穿上盛装；乔装打扮
words.ex: The children dress up as pirates for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在万圣节打扮成海盗。
words.en: To wear formal or special clothes for a particular occasion or to make something or someone look more attractive by adding decorations or details.

words.tr: phrase. 准备好的；有准备的
words.ex: You must be prepared for the test.
words.ex_cn: 你必须为考试做好准备。
words.en: To be ready or to make ready for something that is going to happen.

words.ex: The cat jumped nimbly over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 猫轻盈地跳过了篱笆。
words.en: In a quick and light manner.

words.tr: n. 象牙；象牙色 adj. 象牙色的
words.ex: The old piano has ivory keys.
words.ex_cn: 这架旧钢琴有象牙键。
words.en: Ivory is a hard, white material from the tusks and teeth of animals, which is used to make or decorate objects.

words.ex: The guitarist played a C major chord.
words.ex_cn: 吉他手弹了一个C大和弦。
words.en: A chord is a group of three or more musical notes played together.

words.tr:
adj. 壮丽的；堂皇的；重大的；总的；
n. 大钢琴；
words.ex: The grand castle stood on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 壮丽的城堡矗立在山上。
words.en: If you describe a building or a piece of scenery as grand, you mean that its size or appearance is very impressive.

words.tr: phrase. 站立着；恢复健康；经济上自立；振作起来
words.ex: After the fall, he got on his feet and walked to the door.
words.ex_cn: 摔倒后，他站起身，走到门口。
words.en: If you are on your feet, you are standing up. If you get back on your feet after an illness or difficult period, you recover from it. If a business or economy is on its feet, it is financially successful or stable.

words.ex: The audience gave applause after the song.
words.ex_cn: 歌曲结束后，观众鼓掌了。
words.en: Applause is the noise made by a group of people clapping their hands to show approval or enjoyment.

words.ex: My grandfather passed away last year.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父去年去世了。
words.en: If someone passes away, they die.

words.ex: Parents should foster good habits in children.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该培养孩子的好习惯。
words.en: To foster something means to encourage and promote its development.

words.tr: adj. 膨胀的；松软洁白的；白绒团状的
words.ex: The cat has puffy fur after the bath.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫洗完澡后毛茸茸的。
words.en: If part of your body is puffy, it is swollen because of an injury or because you are unwell.

words.ex: The boy is a piano prodigy at age six.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩六岁时就是一位钢琴奇才。
words.en: A prodigy is someone who is unusually young and has a great natural ability in a particular area.

words.ex: His perseverance helped him finish the marathon.
words.ex_cn: 他的毅力帮助他完成了马拉松。
words.en: Perseverance is the quality of continuing to try to achieve a particular aim despite difficulties.

words.ex: He decided to take a chance and apply for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他决定冒险申请这份工作。
words.en: To do something that involves risk or uncertainty, often with the hope of success.

words.ex: He flung his hat on the chair.
